We know that there is a working group at UQ looking at solutions for biobank data that has associated metadata. One of our colleagues who used to work at the QFC is in this working group so I have forwarded your email to her to see whether she can bring this up at the next meeting for there to be a discussion. We know realistically that these changes to approved instruments for data capture for clinical trials would need exec support and the conversations would require discussion at this level, so I think this would hopefully be the best way we can flag our software as a viable option. Thanks again for taking the time to discuss your software. Best wishes,Danielle
